text:
Asha (CS): Heads up on Zenflo onboarding — they hit 250 req/s and tail latency spiked to 420ms; trial renewal in 6 weeks. Thinking we propose compact quantized model + split routing between compact and standard with fallback. Thoughts?
Marta (Solutions): Thanks Asha — do we have token profile & p95 distribution? any accuracy regressions so far?
Asha (CS): Most calls are short (<40 tokens). p95 tokens ~28. Quality: sporadic hallucination on entity extraction in 0.6% of requests; customer concerned about cost. Logs attached: `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests/zenflo/abcd` (sanitized)
Eli (ML Eng): Recommend int8 quant for base model (v2.1-int8) — should cut inference cost ~2.3x and reduce memory footprint. For latency-sensitive routes keep v2.1-fp16 on dedicated pool as fallback.
Sam (AE): They're price-sensitive, renewal likely if we can show 30% cost savings without quality hit.
Marta (Solutions): Operational plan: canary 5% traffic to int8 for 48h, run eval set of 200 prompts. If pass, ramp to 60% and update routing policy. Need enablement docs & changelog.
Asha (CS): Agree. Can you draft eval prompts? Need to capture feedback loop in case of quality regression. Also coordinate SRE for routing rule.
Eli (ML Eng): I can produce the eval harness. Suggested routing rule snippet:
```
route_policy:
  - match: short_inputs
    model: v2.1-int8
    weight: 0.6
  - match: any
    model: v2.1-fp16
    weight: 0.4
fallback: v2.1-fp16
canary: 0.05
monitoring:
  eval_set: zenflo_onboard_200
  quality_cutoff: 0.02
```
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: canary-route-create zenflo 0.05
Priya (SRE): Added burst autoscale policy for dedicated pool: min=1, max=10, burst_threshold=1000rps. Will watch 3pm PST spike.
Asha (CS): :thumbsup: launching canary today; will post results here in 48h and attach eval metrics + CI diffs.
Marta (Solutions): I'll draft the one-pager for the customer and schedule a Tuesday sync. Also will add a 3-question survey to capture qualitative feedback after canary.
Sam (AE): I'll flag renewal team. If metrics show >=30% TCO reduction, propose a 6mo extension + committed discount.
Asha (CS): Thanks team — prioritizing quality monitoring and rollback hooks. If anything looks off, immediate rollback to fp16.
